title: Common variation of cell abundances and gene expression in the human striatum
title_zh: 人纹状体中细胞丰度和基因表达的常见变异
abstract: The cellular and molecular bases of inter-individual variation in the human brain are not yet understood, particularly beyond the neocortex. Here, we describe cellular and gene-expression variation in the striatum and prefrontal cortex from single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) analysis of 3.9 million nuclei from 178 adult brain donors. People with more astrocytes, microglia, or oligodendrocyte precursor cells (OPCs) in any one brain region tended to have this property in all gray-matter regions sampled. OPC proportions declined by 40% across ages 30-80 in the cortex and striatum. Age-associated gene-expression changes differed substantially across cell types. Donor age was predicted from RNA-expression patterns with a median absolute error of 6.6 years across cell types. Common genetic variants were associated with the expression of nearly 10,000 genes; these effects were mostly cell-type specific and distinguished striatal from cortical neurons. These open-access data provide a foundation for future studies of human brain variation and vulnerabilities.
abstract_zh: 人类脑内个体间细胞和分子差异的基础尚不清楚，特别是大脑皮层之外的区域。本文通过对178名成年脑捐献者的390万个细胞核进行单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）分析，描述了纹状体和前额叶皮层的细胞及基因表达差异。在任何一个脑区中占星细胞、小胶质细胞或少突胶质细胞前体细胞（OPC）比例较高的人，在所有采样的灰质脑区中均倾向于具有这一特征。皮层和纹状体中OPC比例随30-80岁年龄增长下降了40%。年龄相关的基因表达变化在不同细胞类型间差异显著。根据RNA表达模式预测捐献者年龄，不同细胞类型的中位绝对误差为6.6年。常见遗传变异与近10,000个基因的表达相关；这些效应大多具有细胞类型特异性，并区分了纹状体神经元与皮层神经元。这些开放数据为未来研究人类脑差异和易感性奠定了基础。
